items.description: Combined laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact inside the car are covered under 2.6.2–2.6.3, and both damaged areas form one loss; direct payment to the shop does not change coverage under 7.1.12. The comparable split repairs total at least €1,150 gross and the comparable combined repair was accepted at €1,166, supporting a €1,180 gross estimate under 7.1.10, with no stated deductible or sub-limit to apply.
